newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian premier to have kidney check-up in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Russian premier to have kidney check-up in Germany.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin will undergo a routine check-up on his kidneys on Saturday in Germany, where he has been on a working visit, Russian news agencies said.
Chernomyrdin flew from Berlin, where he has held talks with German Chancellor Helmut Kohl, to Frankfurt on Saturday morning, Interfax and Itar-Tass news agencies reported from Berlin.
"There he will undergo a planned examination in the clinic where he had a kidney operation," Interfax said.
Chenomyrdin, who had a kidney stone removed at a university clinic in Mainz near Frankfurt in 1994, is due to return to Moscow on Thursday evening.
He and Kohl hailed a dramatic post Cold War improvement in ties between Russia and Germany but admitted differences over NATO enlargement during the two-day working visit.
